synopsis: The booklet identifies Speedgoat with Simulink Real-Time as a commercial HIL hardware/software offering, providing turnkey real-time targets tightly coupled to Simulink [f16036, f9229, f8645, f9231]. Speedgoat engineering services also provides real-time and HIL integration, but the cited evidence is general HIL rather than off-road-specific, leaving application-specific validation unestablished [f8814, f9230, f16103]. The middle-cost example stack places Speedgoat or NI in later HIL testing, alongside an externally validated sensor model packaged as an OSI FMU and cloud GPUs for batch runs [f9288, f16163]. No public price was found, so the corpus does not establish Speedgoat's actual cost within that example stack [f8647, f9232, f9288]. The latest release found for the combined Speedgoat and Simulink Real-Time entry was Pulse, dated 15 May 2025 [f9233].
